content.title: List of New Glenn launches
content.text: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia New Glenn is a heavy-lift launch vehicle developed by Blue Origin, named after NASA astronaut John Glenn, the first American astronaut to orbit the Earth. It flew to space on its maiden flight on January 16, 2025.
